label: Buy RSI minimum

label: Buy RSI maximum

label: Sell RSI minimum
description: Lower edge of the classic RSI exit range.

label: Sell RSI maximum
description: Upper edge of the classic RSI exit range.

label: RSI length

label: RSI arm minimum
description: Lowest RSI value that arms a recovery setup.

label: RSI arm maximum
description: Highest RSI value that arms a recovery setup.

label: RSI recovery level
description: RSI must cross above this level after arming.

label: RSI arm expiry
description: Completed bars before an armed setup expires; zero never expires.

label: EMA fast length
description: Fast EMA length used by the existing confirmation logic.

label: EMA slow length
description: Slow EMA length used by the existing confirmation logic.

label: Volume EMA length
description: Volume average used by the existing confirmation logic.

label: Minimum confirmations
description: Enabled EMA, VWAP and volume confirmations required.

label: Profit target
description: Target distance from the recorded entry price.

label: Stop loss
description: Fixed stop distance from the actual entry price.

label: Quantity
description: Shares assigned to each accepted position.

label: Maximum open lots
description: Maximum simultaneous positions for one symbol.

label: Maximum holding sessions
description: NSE sessions before the configured time exit.

label: Buy transaction cost
description: Estimated buy-side transaction cost.

label: Sell transaction cost
description: Estimated sell-side transaction cost.

label: Slippage per side
description: Estimated adverse execution slippage per side.

label: ATR length
description: Completed candles used for the ATR exit model.

label: Stop ATR multiplier
description: Multiplier applied to the completed-candle ATR stop.

label: Reward:risk
description: Take-profit distance relative to the frozen ATR stop.

label: Minimum stop
description: Lower clamp for an ATR-derived stop.

label: Maximum stop
description: Upper clamp for an ATR-derived stop.

label: Rupee risk budget
description: Maximum currency risk allocated to one position.

label: Maximum quantity
description: Upper quantity clamp for risk-budget sizing.

label: Maximum capital
description: Maximum capital assigned to one position.

label: Minimum profit
description: Minimum profitable distance before the RSI exit can close.

label: Profit-exit RSI
description: RSI level that permits a profitable exit.

label: Upper RSI level
description: RSI level used for the overbought exit label.

label: Hard stop
description: Mandatory hard-stop distance for RSI profit exits.

label: EMA confirmation
description: Enable the existing EMA trend confirmation.

label: VWAP confirmation
description: Enable the existing session VWAP confirmation.

label: Volume confirmation
description: Enable the existing volume confirmation.

label: Execution model
description: Price used when a completed recovery signal is accepted.

label: Exit model
description: Position exit model used after an RSI Recovery entry.

label: Exit protection enabled
description: Canonical flag indicating that a protected exit model is active.

label: Position sizing
description: Quantity method used by protected RSI Recovery positions.

label: RSI exit execution
description: Execution price used for profitable RSI exits.

label: Time exit
description: Canonical next-session time-exit policy.

label: Quantity
description: Fixed number of whole NSE equity shares per accepted entry.

label: Maximum trades per day
description: Portfolio-wide daily maximum; the strategy never fills a quota.

label: Execution model
description: A completed trigger enters only at the following candle open.

label: Entry start time
description: Earliest completed five-minute trigger accepted.

label: Last entry time
description: Latest completed five-minute trigger accepted.

label: Square-off time
description: Exit all open positions at or before this time.

label: RSI length
description: Completed candles used for Wilder RSI.

label: RSI pullback minimum
description: Lowest RSI that may arm a controlled pullback.

label: RSI pullback maximum
description: Highest RSI that may arm a controlled pullback.

label: RSI trigger level
description: Trigger candle RSI must be strictly above this level.

label: Maximum trigger RSI
description: Cancel or reject a setup when trigger RSI exceeds this value.

label: Setup expiry
description: Completed bars after arming in which a trigger may occur.

label: EMA fast length
description: Fast EMA used for trend and trigger checks.

label: EMA slow length
description: Slow EMA used for trend and pullback structure.

label: EMA slope lookback
description: Completed same-session bars used to confirm rising EMA20.

label: ATR length
description: Completed candles used for Wilder ATR.

label: RVOL period
description: Previous completed bars used for relative volume.

label: Minimum trigger RVOL
description: Minimum relative volume on the completed trigger candle.

label: Maximum holding bars
description: Completed monitoring bars before a next-open time exit.

label: Minimum stop distance
description: Calculated stop risk is widened to at least this percentage.

label: Maximum stop distance
description: Candidates requiring wider risk are skipped.

label: Target reward:risk
description: Frozen take-profit distance in initial risk units.

label: Position sizing
description: Use fixed shares or a rupee risk budget.

label: Rupee risk budget
description: Risk amount used when risk-budget sizing is selected.

label: Maximum quantity
description: Whole-share upper bound for risk-budget sizing.

label: Portfolio capital
description: Capital used for portfolio and daily-loss limits.

label: Maximum capital per position
description: Maximum entry value assigned to one position.

label: Maximum concurrent trades
description: Portfolio-wide simultaneous position limit.

label: Stop after daily losses
description: Stop new entries after this many realized losses in a session.

label: Maximum daily loss
description: Stop new entries after realized losses reach this share of capital.

label: Missing NIFTY policy
description: ADVISORY permits a trade when NIFTY history is genuinely unavailable; REJECT skips it.

label: Enforce minimum quality score
description: Optional research gate; disabled by default.

label: Minimum quality score
description: Applied only when quality-score enforcement is enabled.

label: OI mode
description: OFF ignores OI; ADVISORY records available point-in-time context and never blocks.

label: Buy cost
description: Buy-side transaction cost assumption.

label: Sell cost
description: Sell-side transaction cost assumption.

label: Slippage per side
description: Adverse execution slippage per side.

label: Pullback approach distance
description: Maximum distance to VWAP, EMA9 or EMA20 for arming.

label: EMA20 break distance
description: Cancel below EMA20 by this ATR multiple.

label: Maximum entry gap
description: Skip a next open above the trigger by more than this ATR multiple.

label: Structural stop buffer
description: ATR buffer below the pullback swing low.

label: Volatility stop
description: ATR distance below entry for the volatility stop.

label: Minimum traded value
description: Minimum 20-bar average price times volume per five-minute bar.

label: Maximum candle range
description: Reject historical candles wider than this ATR multiple.

label: Historical spread
description: Historical bid/ask is not fabricated when unavailable.

label: Live maximum spread
description: Live-only spread-quality limit.

label: Market data freshness
description: Maximum age of completed supporting candles.

label: Breadth quality threshold
description: Quality-score breadth contribution threshold.

label: Minimum breadth symbols
description: Minimum point-in-time breadth observations for score availability.

label: Minimum sector members
description: Minimum point-in-time sector observations for score availability.

label: Sector supportive threshold
description: Minimum positive sector-member share for quality scoring.

label: Relative strength lookback
description: Completed bars used for stock, NIFTY and sector returns.

label: High-RVOL score threshold
description: RVOL level earning the quality-score contribution.

label: OI freshness
description: Maximum age for optional advisory OI context.
